properties.displayName: UAV S19 - Failsafe Parameter Unauthorized Modification (FS_* → 0)
properties.description: UAVConfigAudit_CL에서 FS_* 파라미터가 0 또는 이전 값 대비 50% 이하로 감소한 변경 탐지. 직후 UAVFailsafe_CL에서 failsafe_suppressed 이벤트 확인. MITRE: T0838 Modify Alarm Settings
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let fsParams = dynamic(["FS_THR_ENABLE","FS_GCS_ENABLE","FS_EKF_ACTION","FS_CRASH_CHECK","FS_LAND_AERR"]);
let ConfigChange =
    UAVConfigAudit_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where ParamId in (fsParams)
    | extend OldVal = toreal(ParamValueBefore)
    | extend NewVal = toreal(ParamValueAfter)
    | extend isDisabling = NewVal == 0 or (isnotnull(OldVal) and NewVal < OldVal * 0.5)
    | where isDisabling
    | project T1=TimeGenerated, UAVId, ParamId, OldVal, NewVal;
let FailsafeViolation =
    UAVFailsafe_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where EventType == 'failsafe_suppressed'
    | project T2=TimeGenerated, UAVId, EventType;
ConfigChange
| join kind=leftouter (FailsafeViolation) on UAVId
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isnotnull(T2) and T2 >= T1, strcat("Failsafe_비활성화_억제이벤트_확인_", ParamId, "_", tostring(OldVal), "→", tostring(NewVal)),
    strcat("Failsafe_파라미터_비인가_비활성화_", ParamId, "_", tostring(OldVal), "→", tostring(NewVal)))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project T1, UAVId, ParamId, OldVal, NewVal, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by T1 desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S19 - Failsafe Parameter Unauthorized Modification (FS_* → 0) - {{UAVId}}
